notes.note:
Fixed thin lines in PDFs printing as thick black boxes on some printers on Windows. ([Bug 2091728][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2091728

Fixed PDFs, web page graphics, and WebGL content appearing blank or broken on Macs with AMD graphics, such as black cells in Google Sheets. ([Bug 2091596][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2091596

Fixed incorrect colors in WebGL and canvas content, such as games and Google Meet backgrounds, on some Linux systems using Wayland. ([Bug 2089043][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2089043

Fixed links on some sites, such as the Google Store, taking a very long time to load. ([Bug 2087787][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2087787
Fixed tabs crashing on some sites, most notably ChatGPT. ([Bug 2088486](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2088486))

Fixed WebTransport connections being unable to send datagrams after a site sent many in quick succession.  ([Bug 2092532][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2092532

Fixed trackpad and mouse swipes sometimes scrolling the page when a site had blocked scrolling. ([Bug 2086786][1])


  [1]: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2086786

system_requirements:
## Windows

### Operating Systems (32-bit and 64-bit)
 - Windows 10 or later

### Recommended Hardware
-  1 gigahertz (GHz) or faster compatible processor or System on a Chip (SoC)
-  1GB of RAM / 2GB of RAM for the 64-bit version
-  500MB of hard drive space

---

## Mac

### Operating Systems
- macOS 10.15 or later 

### Recommended Hardware
- Macintosh computer with an Intel x86 or Apple silicon processor
- 512 MB of RAM
- 200 MB hard drive space

---

## GNU/Linux

### Software Requirements

*Please note that GNU/Linux distributors may provide packages for your distribution which have different requirements.*


- Firefox will not run at all without the following libraries or packages:
    - glibc 2.17 or higher (glibc 2.28 or higher on arm64)
    - GTK+ 3.14 or higher
    - libglib 2.42 or higher
    - libstdc++ 4.8.1 or higher (libstdc++ 6.0 or higher on arm64)
    - X.Org 1.0 or higher (1.7 or higher is recommended)
- For optimal functionality, we recommend the following libraries or packages:
    - DBus 1.0 or higher
    - NetworkManager 0.7 or higher
    - PulseAudio
